Now I see the issue. In `UA_calcSizeJson`, `ctx.end` is set to `SIZE_MAX` (essentially infinite), and `ctx.calcOnly = true`. The `ByteString_encodeJson` function checks `if(ctx->pos + flen > ctx->end)` but when `calcOnly` is true, `ctx->pos` is 0 and `ctx->end` is SIZE_MAX, so this check passes. But the issue is about **use-of-uninitialized-value**.
